description: This file implements the 'Edit' feature for articles in an ASP.NET Core application, including command validation and handling logic for updating articles, managing tags, and handling errors.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Encapsulates the command, validation, and handler for editing articles, including logic to fetch, update, and manage related tags and handle errors.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to edit an article, updates fields, manages tags, and persists changes to the database.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article based on the provided tag list.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags no longer apply and need to be removed from the article.
